_enforce_thresholds_comment: false = record-only: this is a brand-new model with NO measured MI325X baselines yet, so no metric gates. Populate the sibling *_threshold.json with real mins after the first runs, then flip this to true.
_model_comment: DeepSeek-V4 284B. NOTE: 'DeepSeek-V4-Pro' has no MaxText training preset; the only 284B V4 preset shipped in maxtext is 'deepseek4-284b', whose yml header identifies it as DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B (hf: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash). This config uses that preset as the stand-in for the full-size V4 model. Swap model_name/tokenizer once a V4-Pro preset exists.

training._maxtext_branch_comment: After container launch, cd to maxtext_root, `git reset --hard`, and `git checkout maxtext_branch`. Empty maxtext_branch = leave the image's MaxText checkout as-is. maxtext_install_cmd (run verbatim from maxtext_root after checkout) installs the branch's deps: MaxText installs its CODE with --no-deps and its DEPS from a requirements file (see src/dependencies/scripts/setup.sh and maxtext_rocm_dependencies.Dockerfile), so a plain `pip install -e .` does NOT update deps like JAX. NOTE: the ROCm jax pjrt/plugin come from AMD's index and must match the base image's ROCm SDK; if a branch needs a newer JAX than the image ships, a runtime install may not fully fix it -- an image built from that branch is the clean fix.
training._maxtext_install_cmd_comment: maxtext_install_cmd runs verbatim from maxtext_root right after the branch checkout (empty = no install). Typical use: `python3 -m pip install --no-deps -e .` makes the checked-out branch the imported MaxText package without disturbing the image's jax/rocm stack. Add explicit packages here if the branch needs extra pure-python deps; avoid re-pinning jax/jaxlib/jax-rocm unless the image's versions are incompatible with the branch (a mismatched runtime pip install can break the image's compiled stack -- an image built from the branch is the clean fix).
training._model_name_comment: DeepSeek-V4 284B = MaxText preset 'deepseek4-284b' (DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B MoE). The architecture is supplied by maxtext's src/maxtext/configs/models/deepseek4-284b.yml; DO NOT restate arch params here (any unknown key in maxtext_config is written to the run yml and rejected by MaxText). The maxtext_config below only carries the runtime/sharding/precision knobs, mirroring the deepseek2-16b reference where applicable.
training._model_arch_reference_comment: For reference only (from deepseek4-284b.yml, NOT applied here): emb_dim=4096, query_heads=64, kv_heads=1, decoder_layers=43, mlp_dim=2048, moe_mlp_dim=2048, vocab_size=129280, head_dim=512, qk_rope_head_dim=64; decoder_block=deepseek4; MoE: num_experts=256, num_experts_per_tok=6, shared_experts=1, routed_scaling_factor=1.5, mlp_activations=[silu,linear]; attention_type=compressed, q_lora_rank=1024, o_lora_rank=1024, o_groups=8, sliding_window_size=128; rope theta=10000 (compressed=160000), max_position_embeddings=1048576.
training._starting_point_comment: Runtime/sharding/precision knobs for deepseek4-284b (arch itself comes from the preset yml -- see _model_name_comment). attention=dot_product; DENSE MoE (sparse_matmul=false, megablox=false -- GMM/megablox is TPU-only); ici_expert_parallelism=-1 + dcn_fsdp_parallelism=-1. NOTES: (1) NNODES is injected from the cluster_file. (2) BS=1 / seq=2048 is the memory-safe reference; raise only with headroom. (3) keep dense MoE until the image ships a GPU GMM. (4) training here is from random init on synthetic data; real convergence needs load_parameters_path from a converted DeepSeek-V4-Flash ckpt. Add or remove maxtext_config params below for your experiment.
training._dataset_comment: Data source for the run. Default 'synthetic' = random token ids (no tokenizer/data download; good for throughput/functional runs, but the model overfits fixed noise so the loss is NOT a real curve and eventually NaNs). For a genuine loss curve set INSIDE maxtext_config: dataset_type=hf, hf_path=allenai/c4, hf_data_dir=en, train_split=train, tokenizer_type=huggingface. HF C4 STREAMS data (no ~300GB download); tokenizer_type=huggingface is required so MaxText loads the DeepSeek-V4-Flash tokenizer.json (the sentencepiece default would mismatch it), and real data auto-downloads the tokenizer from tokenizer.hf_model_id. IMPORTANT: comment keys must stay OUT of maxtext_config -- every key inside maxtext_config is written verbatim to the run yml and any unknown key is rejected by MaxText; keep notes at this training level instead.
training._rdma_lib_comment: Backup 2-stage user-lib copy, used ONLY when a direct read-only volume mount of the NIC's RDMA user lib (.so) into the container is not allowed. In that case mount the host lib as '<name>.so.host' (container_mount_file) and it is copied to the real '<name>.so' (container_dest_file) inside the container after launch. When the .so is bind-mounted :ro directly (the current default), this block is unused.
training._env_vars_comment: Environment variables exported on every node before launch. NCCL_* are cluster-specific RDMA/NIC networking; NVTE_* tune the fused-attention / Composable-Kernel path; XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION caps the JIT allocator's share of GPU memory (0.85 leaves headroom on 256GB MI325X). Add or remove entries for your experiment.
training._xla_flags_comment: Extra XLA knobs as name->value, exported as --name=value in XLA_FLAGS (empty {} = MaxText/XLA defaults). Add relevant xla_gpu_* flags for your experiment.
training._nccl_comment: Cluster-specific RDMA/NIC devices. Replace every '<changeme>' with your node's values (see the sibling _example_* entries); distributed runs hard-exit at config load until you do. Discover them with `ibv_devices` (HCAs) and `ip -br link` (host interface).
training._scaling_baseline_comment: 1-node total tokens/sec baseline for scaling-efficiency %. 0.0 = disabled (record-only). A 284B model will not fit on a single node, so this likely stays disabled; use a multi-node run as the reference instead.
training._convergence_comment: target_value <= 0 disables convergence (record-only). No baseline loss target for this model yet.
training._loss_curve_comment: Record-only (enforce=false) until we have a reference loss curve for this model. Samples training loss every `sample_every` steps.
training._smoke_comment: Smoke test (test_smoke), ENABLED by default. Loads the model and runs `steps` steps at a small fixed batch/seqlen in BF16; passes if no error signature fires (no metric checks). A failure gates the rest of the suite. Set enabled=false to SKIP it during iterative experiments (opt-out). steps/per_device_batch_size/max_target_length tune the smoke run.
training._checkpoint_resume_comment: Opt-in checkpoint save+resume + I/O-time test (test_checkpoint_resume). enabled=false -> skipped. Runs ONE sweep (the `sweep` name, else the first enabled) twice: train steps_before_ckpt (checkpoint written at checkpoint_period), then resume + train steps_after_resume; passes if it restarts from the checkpoint step and the boundary loss matches within loss_tolerance. max_save_seconds/max_load_seconds gate checkpoint I/O time (0 = record-only). smoke_model_overrides can shrink the model while keeping the same tokenizer/vocab, e.g. {"base_num_decoder_layers": 4}; empty = the config's full model. delete_ckpt_dir=true deletes the checkpoint directory after the test to free disk (set false to keep the files for inspection).
training._error_patterns_comment: Regexes (name -> pattern) scanned in each node's training.log during polling; a match fails that sweep's training_run with the matched name. Add/remove entries as you find new error signatures. Remove this block to use the built-in defaults. Escape backslashes per JSON (e.g. two backslashes for a regex \d).

error_patterns.NCCL ERROR: NCCL ERROR|NCCL timeout|local work queue catastrophic error
error_patterns.GPU HW ERROR: HW Exception by GPU|GPU Hang|Uncorrectable error|GPU Reset
error_patterns.AssertionError: AssertionError|ValueError:|JaxStackTrace|During handling of the above exception|triggered the following exception
error_patterns.rocm Err: FAILED_PRECONDITION: No visible GPU devices|failed call to hipInit: HIP_ERROR_NoDevice|librocm reported version is: NOT_FOUND
error_patterns.python err: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named|Fatal Python error:

training.__comment_NNODES_: NNODES is 'auto': the real node count is injected at runtime from the cluster_file (the training launcher exports NNODES=<num_nodes>), so this value is a placeholder and is overridden.
training._sweeps_comment: Each sweep = one full training run with per-run maxtext overrides; `name` is the threshold cell key. NNODES/GBS in the name are informational labels; per_device_batch_size drives the run and the real global batch = per_device_batch_size * (nodes * gpus_per_node) at runtime. DeepSeek-V4 284B is BF16 here. enabled_sweep_list selects which sweeps to run.
